    • Class io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe.Aggregator

      class Aggregator extends Object implements Serializable

      • Serialized Fields

        • aggregations
          Map<String,ToDoubleFunction<Series>> aggregations
          A map that holds aggregation functions associated with column names. The keys represent the names of the target columns for the results of the aggregation, and the values are functions that define the aggregation logic. Each function takes a Series as input and produces a Double as the result of the aggregation. This map is used to configure and store multiple aggregation operations to be applied on data, where each operation corresponds to a specific target column.
        • columnsMapping
          Map<String,String> columnsMapping
          A mapping of output column names to input column names. Used to define how aggregation operations map input data columns to their corresponding resulting columns.
